tests.name: Exact candidate IDs and technical provenance are checked against the checksum-validated cached SQLite source
Only proposals actually present in the source are listed with conserved quantities and zones
An empty selection conserves all printed passcodes and does not select a candidate
Explicit decisions produce the independently expected IDs and merge quantities without moving zones
The exported JSON normalizes through the actual existing importer with all zones and context intact
Merged families above three remain present and carry diagnostic incidents without legality claims
Source, choices, output, active deck, actual engine state and goal are detached across successful and failed decisions
Malformed, duplicate, unknown, absent and invented candidate choices are rejected transactionally
Executable properties and sparse or non-JSON values cannot become review decisions or source data
A full source fingerprint binds quantities, all zones, name, build, format and declared context
Changes to the live deck or semantic context invalidate old source snapshots without mutating them
Main and Extra incompatibility is rejected without automatic movement or source repair
Ambiguous technical token proposals retain every candidate and no manual choice makes Tokens deckable
Recognized identity-specific evidence is retained for kept IDs and explicitly omitted for a changed ID
Conflicting evidence on converging rows is not silently dropped or promoted to the candidate
Format context and independent Skills round-trip through the existing normalizer
Reverification recomputes copy IDs, quantities, source decisions, provenance, summary, context and audit
A candidate-valid edited source and recomputed fingerprint still fail against the expected original source
Presentation edits and externally modified proposals cannot invent candidates or alter the immutable preview names
Build or inventory changes fail closed while source and catalogue diagnostics remain read-only
The final UTF-8 JSON copy cannot exceed the actual existing 4 MiB file import limit
Backend-only use exposes no prepared browser download and does not apply any copy

limitations: Technical exact-name candidates are not official passcode equivalence, release or ruling certification.
The copy workflow does not mutate or replace the active deck, catalogue, laboratory state, goal or competitive scoring.
Source comparison is an explicit data binding, not a cryptographic authorship signature; actual browser downloads/file imports and stale controls are tested in GUI15.

meaning: Passed local Node source cases from the preserved complete local run; remote whole-release acceptance is recorded separately through mandatory CI gates. These are not downloaded remote result files.
